view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle with tall metal shelving units stocked with boxes on wooden pallets. The floor is concrete, and the space extends into the distance with more racks and a forklift visible. Lighting comes from overhead fixtures. Boxes vary in color: red, white with yellow bands, and green. Yellow protective bumpers are mounted on shelf legs.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall black metal shelving units line the left and right sides of the aisle. They have multiple levels holding stacked boxes. The shelves extend far into the background, creating depth. Some shelves appear to hold blue containers on the far left.

objects.label: stacked boxes
objects.observation: Boxes are stacked high on wooden pallets along the aisle. In the foreground, bright red boxes with green logos sit on a pallet. Behind them, white boxes with yellow bands are stacked neatly. Further down, other colored boxes (red, green) are visible. All are supported by pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Light-colored wooden pallets support the stacked boxes. They are placed directly on the concrete floor. One pallet is in the immediate foreground, another runs along the aisle, and more are visible further back under the shelves.

objects.label: yellow protective bumper
objects.observation: Yellow vertical bumpers with black stripes are mounted on the front legs of the shelving units. They are positioned at the aisle edge to prevent collisions. Two are clearly visible near the foreground boxes.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor is smooth, light gray concrete. It stretches across the entire frame, forming the ground surface for the pallets and aisles. It reflects some overhead lighting and shows faint marks from traffic.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: A forklift is visible in the distant background on the right side of the aisle. It is partially obscured by shelves and boxes. Its body appears gray, and it is parked or moving slowly along the aisle.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-31857", "image_size": [1280, 800], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
